name: Blueleaf Tubers
summary: Mebok Mizzyrix seeks Blueleaf Tubers beneath the roots of Razorfen Kraul. The Ratchet goblin merchant sends trained snufflenose gophers to find and dig them up for trade.

sections.title: A Prized Subterranean Delicacy
sections.body: Blueleaf tubers are prized as a rare culinary delicacy across the world. They are hard to harvest because they do not grow in open fields or ordinary wild groves. Foragers find them deep underground in the southern Barrens, tangled among the roots of Razorfen Kraul.

sections.title: Mizzyrix's Ingenuity
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix, a merchant in Ratchet, devised a way to find the buried tubers. He trains snufflenose gophers, whose noses can catch a tuber's scent from fifty paces away. He supplies foragers with a command stick, a ventilated crate, and an instruction manual to guide the creatures through quilboar territory.

sections.title: Harvesting in the Thorns
sections.body: Harvesting the tubers means entering the lands of the hostile Death's Head quilboar tribe. Foragers must guard their trained gophers from feral beasts and thorny briars in the Kraul, then command the rodents to dig up the buried bulbs. The tubers go back to Ratchet, where Mizzyrix's foreign buyers await.

faq.q: What are Blueleaf Tubers used for?
faq.answer: Blueleaf Tubers are prized as a rare culinary delicacy around the world. Wealthy buyers pay well for fresh tubers, making them a profitable trade good for goblins like Mebok Mizzyrix.
Blueleaf Tubers lie beneath the earth and thorny roots of the southern Barrens, inside the quilboar stronghold of Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Why do you need a Snufflenose Gopher to find them?
faq.answer: The tubers are buried underground and cannot be seen with ordinary eyesight. A snufflenose gopher can smell them from up to fifty paces away and dig them out.
Mebok Mizzyrix is a goblin merchant who works from Ratchet, a neutral port town in the Barrens. He trains native wildlife and acquires exotic goods for foreign trade.

faq.q: What equipment does Mizzyrix provide for the job?
faq.answer: Mizzyrix provides a Crate with Holes containing a trained gopher, a Snufflenose Command Stick to direct its digging, and a Snufflenose Owner's Manual explaining how to handle the beast.

faq.q: Why can't Mebok gather the tubers himself?
faq.answer: Razorfen Kraul is guarded by aggressive quilboar tribes, thorny vines, and dangerous creatures beneath the earth. Mizzyrix sends others into the barrows rather than risk going himself.

angles.text: As a cook, you know blueleaf tubers rank among Azeroth's rarest delicacies. Elite buyers prize their earthy flavor.
As a herbalist, you know blueleaf tubers grow underground among Razorfen's briar roots, away from sunlight.
As an Alliance traveler, you can use Mizzyrix's trade contract in neutral Ratchet to enter territory near Horde lands.
As a Horde warrior defending the Barrens from quilboar incursions, you can earn coin by guiding Mizzyrix's trained gophers through the Kraul.
